desc_save_settings_1: Save settings for the next time you open the app.
desc_save_settings_2: This will create a settings file in the %AppData% folder.
desc_preload_data_1: Preload all data the app will need on launch.
desc_preload_data_2: This includes champions list, summoner spells list and more.
desc_instalock_pick_1: Instanly lock in when it's your turn to pick.
desc_instalock_ban_1: Instanly lock in when it's your turn to ban.
desc_bypass_lock_delay: This will bypass the lock in delay setting.
desc_auto_trade_pick_order: Automatically trade pick order when someone requests to.
desc_instant_hover_1: Instantly hover champion as soon as joining champ select.
desc_instant_hover_2: In draft pick, it will hover before you are normally able to.
desc_auto_restart_queue_1: Automatically restart queue every few minutes.
desc_auto_restart_queue_2: Default is 5 mintues, can be configured in the delays settings.
desc_cancel_queue_dodge: Automatically cancel the queue after someone dodges the lobby.
desc_language: Choose the language used across the app.
pick_hover_delay: Pick hover delay upon phase start
pick_lock_delay_start: Pick lock delay upon phase start
pick_lock_delay_end: Pick lock delay before phase end
ban_hover_delay: Ban hover delay upon phase start
ban_lock_delay_start: Ban lock delay upon phase start
ban_lock_delay_end: Ban lock delay before phase end
desc_pick_hover_delay: Delay after which to hover your pick.
desc_pick_lock_delay_start: Delay after which to lock in your pick, after you are able to.
desc_pick_lock_delay_end: Time to lock in before your time runs out.
desc_lock_end_warning: Do not set too low (<300), it will cause you to dodge. Default is 1000.
desc_ban_hover_delay: Delay after which to hover your ban.
desc_ban_lock_delay_end: Time to lock in before your time runs out
desc_max_queue_time: How long should the queue be before cancelling and restarting it?
desc_chat_messages_delay: Delay after which the chat messages will be sent
console_width_too_small: Console width is too small. Please resize it.
console_height_too_small: Console height is too small. Please resize it.
desc_enable_bravery_1: Enable or disable bravery for arena games.
desc_enable_bravery_2: This will pick bravery in arena games over your selected champion
desc_ban_crowd_favourite_1: Enable or disable banning one of the selected crowd favourite champion
desc_ban_crowd_favourite_2: If true and the ban matches one of the crowd favourite champions, It will ban None.
desc_crowd_favourite_1st: Select the first crowd favourite champion to be picked in arena
desc_crowd_favourite_2nd: Select the second crowd favourite champion to be picked in arena
desc_crowd_favourite_3rd: Select the third crowd favourite champion to be picked in arena
desc_crowd_favourite_4th: Select the fourth crowd favourite champion to be picked in arena
desc_crowd_favourite_5th: Select the fifth crowd favourite champion to be picked in arena
desc_picked_over_bravery: This will be picked over bravery.
